records.key: A failed or incomplete run was found; review its outputs before continuing.
records.source: A failed or incomplete run was found; review its outputs before continuing.
records.translation: 실패했거나 완료되지 않은 실행을 찾았습니다. 계속하기 전에 해당 출력물을 검토하세요.

records.key: All compatible plates
records.source: All compatible plates
records.translation: 호환되는 모든 플레이트

records.key: Cellpose *_seg.npy bundles use their separate editor route.
records.source: Cellpose *_seg.npy bundles use their separate editor route.
records.translation: Cellpose *_seg.npy 번들은 별도의 편집기 경로를 사용합니다.

records.key: Choose a module
records.source: Choose a module
records.translation: 모듈 선택

records.key: Choose a parent folder for the Make Masks copy
records.source: Choose a parent folder for the Make Masks copy
records.translation: Make Masks 복사본의 상위 폴더 선택

records.key: Choose a plate
records.source: Choose a plate
records.translation: 플레이트 선택

records.key: Copied {n} image/mask pair(s) to {destination}.
records.source: Copied {n} image/mask pair(s) to {destination}.
records.translation: 이미지/마스크 쌍 {n}개를 {destination}에 복사했습니다.

records.key: Copy cancelled.
records.source: Copy cancelled.
records.translation: 복사가 취소되었습니다.

records.key: Copy {n} matched image/mask pair(s) into images/ and masks/ inside a new Make Masks folder? Choose its parent folder next. The originals stay unchanged. Cancel changes nothing.
records.source: Copy {n} matched image/mask pair(s) into images/ and masks/ inside a new Make Masks folder? Choose its parent folder next. The originals stay unchanged. Cancel changes nothing.
records.translation: 일치하는 이미지/마스크 쌍 {n}개를 새 Make Masks 폴더 안의 images/와 masks/에 복사할까요? 다음으로 상위 폴더를 선택하세요. 원본은 변경되지 않습니다. 취소하면 아무것도 변경되지 않습니다.

records.key: Could not prepare image/mask pairs
records.source: Could not prepare image/mask pairs
records.translation: 이미지/마스크 쌍을 준비할 수 없습니다

records.key: Create a Make Masks copy?
records.source: Create a Make Masks copy?
records.translation: Make Masks 복사본을 만들까요?

records.key: Dose Response
records.source: Dose Response
records.translation: 용량-반응

records.key: Each image must have exactly one matching mask.
records.source: Each image must have exactly one matching mask.
records.translation: 각 이미지에는 정확히 하나의 일치하는 마스크가 있어야 합니다.

records.key: FASTQ reads were found in this folder.
records.source: FASTQ reads were found in this folder.
records.translation: 이 폴더에서 FASTQ 리드를 찾았습니다.

records.key: Fitted regression coefficients were found in this folder.
records.source: Fitted regression coefficients were found in this folder.
records.translation: 이 폴더에서 적합된 회귀 계수를 찾았습니다.

records.key: Image and mask dimensions are incompatible: {image}
records.source: Image and mask dimensions are incompatible: {image}
records.translation: 이미지와 마스크의 크기가 호환되지 않습니다: {image}

records.key: Image and mask names are ambiguous or collide in the new folder.
records.source: Image and mask names are ambiguous or collide in the new folder.
records.translation: 이미지와 마스크 이름이 모호하거나 새 폴더에서 충돌합니다.

records.key: Image or mask is missing or unsupported: {path}
records.source: Image or mask is missing or unsupported: {path}
records.translation: 이미지 또는 마스크가 없거나 지원되지 않습니다: {path}

records.key: Multi-frame raster images need explicit frame or axis selection; no frames were imported.
records.source: Multi-frame raster images need explicit frame or axis selection; no frames were imported.
records.translation: 다중 프레임 래스터 이미지는 프레임 또는 축을 명시적으로 선택해야 합니다. 가져온 프레임은 없습니다.

records.key: NPY data is truncated: {path}
records.source: NPY data is truncated: {path}
records.translation: NPY 데이터가 잘렸습니다: {path}

records.key: NPY header is missing, invalid, or too large: {path}
records.source: NPY header is missing, invalid, or too large: {path}
records.translation: NPY 헤더가 없거나 잘못되었거나 너무 큽니다: {path}

records.key: NPY import requires a real numeric array without objects or structured fields.
records.source: NPY import requires a real numeric array without objects or structured fields.
records.translation: NPY 가져오기에는 객체나 구조화된 필드가 없는 실수 값의 숫자 배열이 필요합니다.

records.key: NPY import requires a two-dimensional YX image; arrays with other dimensions need explicit axis selection.
records.source: NPY import requires a two-dimensional YX image; arrays with other dimensions need explicit axis selection.
records.translation: NPY 가져오기에는 2차원 YX 이미지가 필요합니다. 다른 차원의 배열은 축을 명시적으로 선택해야 합니다.

records.key: NPY source shape or dtype changed after the import preview: {path}
records.source: NPY source shape or dtype changed after the import preview: {path}
records.translation: 가져오기 미리보기 이후 NPY 원본의 모양 또는 dtype이 변경되었습니다: {path}

records.key: Navigator
records.source: Navigator
records.translation: Navigator

records.key: Numeric columns were found in this table.
records.source: Numeric columns were found in this table.
records.translation: 이 테이블에서 숫자 열을 찾았습니다.

records.key: OPS tile filenames were found; review acquisition sources before continuing.
records.source: OPS tile filenames were found; review acquisition sources before continuing.
records.translation: OPS 타일 파일 이름을 찾았습니다. 계속하기 전에 영상 획득 소스를 검토하세요.

records.key: Open saved settings
records.source: Open saved settings
records.translation: 저장된 설정 열기

records.key: Open this ChemDraw structure in ChemDraw or compatible chemistry software. spaCR does not read chemical structure documents.
records.source: Open this ChemDraw structure in ChemDraw or compatible chemistry software. spaCR does not read chemical structure documents.
records.translation: 이 ChemDraw 구조를 ChemDraw 또는 호환되는 화학 소프트웨어에서 여세요. spaCR은 화학 구조 문서를 읽지 않습니다.

records.key: Open this FlowJo file in FlowJo. To use its measurements in spaCR, export a numeric CSV for Graph Builder or Gate Editor.
records.source: Open this FlowJo file in FlowJo. To use its measurements in spaCR, export a numeric CSV for Graph Builder or Gate Editor.
records.translation: 이 FlowJo 파일을 FlowJo에서 여세요. spaCR에서 측정값을 사용하려면 Graph Builder 또는 Gate Editor용 숫자 CSV로 내보내세요.

records.key: Open this GraphPad Prism file in GraphPad Prism. To use its measurements in spaCR, export a numeric CSV for Graph Builder or Gate Editor.
records.source: Open this GraphPad Prism file in GraphPad Prism. To use its measurements in spaCR, export a numeric CSV for Graph Builder or Gate Editor.
records.translation: 이 GraphPad Prism 파일을 GraphPad Prism에서 여세요. spaCR에서 측정값을 사용하려면 Graph Builder 또는 Gate Editor용 숫자 CSV로 내보내세요.

records.key: Open this PDB/mmCIF or AlphaFold model in ChimeraX or PyMOL. spaCR does not analyze molecular structures.
records.source: Open this PDB/mmCIF or AlphaFold model in ChimeraX or PyMOL. spaCR does not analyze molecular structures.
records.translation: 이 PDB/mmCIF 또는 AlphaFold 모델을 ChimeraX 또는 PyMOL에서 여세요. spaCR은 분자 구조를 분석하지 않습니다.

records.key: Preview these settings before applying them.
records.source: Preview these settings before applying them.
records.translation: 적용하기 전에 이 설정을 미리 확인하세요.

records.key: Raster image dimensions or channels changed after the import preview: {path}
records.source: Raster image dimensions or channels changed after the import preview: {path}
records.translation: 가져오기 미리보기 이후 래스터 이미지의 크기 또는 채널이 변경되었습니다: {path}

records.key: Regression diagnostics
records.source: Regression diagnostics
records.translation: 회귀 진단

records.key: Review this PDF in Plaque Assay before running.
records.source: Review this PDF in Plaque Assay before running.
records.translation: 실행하기 전에 Plaque Assay에서 이 PDF를 검토하세요.

records.key: Scientific measurements were found in this database.
records.source: Scientific measurements were found in this database.
records.translation: 이 데이터베이스에서 과학적 측정값을 찾았습니다.

records.key: Sequencing counts were found in this table.
records.source: Sequencing counts were found in this table.
records.translation: 이 테이블에서 시퀀싱 집계값을 찾았습니다.

records.key: Spatial Map
records.source: Spatial Map
records.translation: 공간 지도

records.key: Spatial acquisition metadata and a morphology image were found.
records.source: Spatial acquisition metadata and a morphology image were found.
records.translation: 공간 획득 메타데이터와 형태학 이미지를 찾았습니다.

records.key: Spatial measurements match this acquisition; review masks before continuing.
records.source: Spatial measurements match this acquisition; review masks before continuing.
records.translation: 공간 측정값이 이 획득 데이터와 일치합니다. 계속하기 전에 마스크를 검토하세요.

records.key: The destination already exists: {path}
records.source: The destination already exists: {path}
records.translation: 대상이 이미 존재합니다: {path}

records.key: The source changed while it was being copied: {path}
records.source: The source changed while it was being copied: {path}
records.translation: 복사하는 동안 원본이 변경되었습니다: {path}

records.key: This module cannot apply the selected settings.
records.source: This module cannot apply the selected settings.
records.translation: 이 모듈은 선택한 설정을 적용할 수 없습니다.
